title: Purple Worm Gullet
summary: Extract three gullets to make Suspension of Purple Worm Slime.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Purple Worm Gullets into Suspension of Purple Worm Slime. Add any Vitriol to make Purple Worm Toxin.
fields.Acquisition: Waning Moon back room, or buy from Popper.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
